pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo gandhavaṇṇakena nahāyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo gandhavaṇṇakena nahāyissanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo gandhavaṇṇakena nahāyissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo gandhavaṇṇakena nahāyantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo gandhavaṇṇakena nahāyissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī gandhavaṇṇakena nahāyeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc88:2.1.10: nahāyati payoge dukkaṭaṃ nahānapariyosāne āpatti pācittiyassa.
